title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 25 | The Clockwork Workshop | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
Tick, tock, whirr! Kuku presses the big red button, a tiny turret pops out, and Gear the Engineer joins the party. Together they switch off the runaway Robo-Golem and build a little airship.

0:00 Tick, Tock, Whirr
0:45 Gear the Engineer
1:30 The Robo-Golem
2:15 Building an Airship

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
